picks.question: Will the unemployment rate (U-3) be above 4.1% in October?
picks.why: Unemployment above 4.1% would signal a cooling labor market, shaping Federal Reserve rate decisions and household income expectations heading into 2027.

picks.question: Will inflation reach more than 4.5% in 2026?
picks.why: Inflation topping 4.5% would erode real wages and pressure the Fed to keep policy tighter for longer.

picks.question: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by December 31?
picks.why: About a fifth of global oil passes through Hormuz, so prolonged disruption keeps energy prices, shipping costs and inflation elevated.

picks.question: Billionaire one-time wealth tax passes in California election 2026?
picks.why: A state-level billionaire wealth tax would test whether taxing wealth rather than income can raise revenue without driving capital away.

picks.question: Will OpenAI announce another Millennium Prize solution by December 31, 2027?
picks.why: AI solving a famous unsolved math problem would show it can do frontier research, with big implications for productivity and innovation.

picks.question: Will Google have the best AI model at the end of December 2026?
picks.why: Which firm leads in AI shapes where investment, market power and potential productivity gains concentrate in the economy.
